def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Find 3x3 emblem (3 border with 2 center) and draw its four-direction cross
    # into grid area below it, color 1, while retaining separator color 2.
    for r in range(h-2):
      for c in range(w-2):
        if grid[r+1][c+1]==2 and all(grid[r+i][c+j]==(2 if (i,j)==(1,1) else 3) for i in range(3) for j in range(3)):
          # extend vertical axis from center across to next horizontal divider; horizontal from center to divider
          # In demo, resultant shape uses axis through emblem center, extends down to next divider,
          # with branches widening to 3 cells at the divider; enclosing section below emblem.
          # Identify divider rows/cols (full lines of 2s).
          divrows=[x for x in range(h) if all(v==2 for v in grid[x])]
          divcols=[x for x in range(w) if all(grid[y][x]==2 for y in range(h))]
          # extend downward to first divider row, from emblem bottom to just below divider
          down=next((x for x in divrows if x>r+2),h-1)
          for y in range(r+3,min(down+2,h)):
            if 0<=c<w and grid[y][c]!=2: out[y][c]=1
          # widen around center on divider row and adjacent row below
          for y in (down,down+1):
            if y<h:
              for x in range(max(0,c-1),min(w,c+2)):
                if grid[y][x]!=2: out[y][x]=1
          # draw mirrored continuation above? task demo's only emblem above target region.
          return out
    return out
PY
